description: This file contains callback implementations for nghttp2 session events, used in HTTP/2 protocol handling within the quiche library. It defines how to handle various frame events, errors, and data transmission callbacks.

methods.name: OnReadyToSend
methods.description: Handles the event when data is ready to be sent over the nghttp2 session.

methods.name: OnBeginFrame
methods.description: Called at the start of a new frame, processes frame header info.

methods.name: OnFrameReceived
methods.description: Processes a received frame, dispatching to appropriate visitor methods based on frame type.

methods.name: OnBeginHeaders
methods.description: Called at the start of header block processing.

methods.name: OnHeader
methods.description: Handles individual header fields within a header block.

methods.name: OnBeforeFrameSent
methods.description: Invoked before a frame is sent, logs and allows modification.

methods.name: OnFrameSent
methods.description: Called after a frame has been sent, reports success or error.

methods.name: OnFrameNotSent
methods.description: Handles failure to send a frame, performs cleanup if necessary.

methods.name: OnInvalidFrameReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of invalid frames, reports errors.

methods.name: OnDataChunk
methods.description: Processes chunks of data received for a stream.

methods.name: OnExtensionChunkReceived
methods.description: Processes received extension frames, such as metadata.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes nghttp2 session callbacks with assigned functions.
